Oasis.ai is an AI-powered and generated game that allows you to "play Minecraft through AI-generated frames, also trained with the interaction of each button, which allows further gameplay. Since it's an AI-generated game, it does not have memory, doesn't store or remember anything about your location, but can only predict the next frame through the current low-resolution frame picture.
